bio: In a pleasingly relaxed setting, diners are treated to dishes brimming with flavour and culinary flair. Alongside time-honoured classics such as Wiener schnitzel of veal with fried potatoes and cranberries or Zwiebelrostbraten (braised beef with onions and gravy) with cheese spaetzle and a rosemary and thyme jus, the kitchen also turns out more contemporary dishes: "Black salsify soup, beetroot, cream cheese, parsley" or "Zander, cucumber, mustard, dill". There is a three- or four-course set menu (meat/fish or vegetarian) as well as à la carte options. Clean lines, warm natural tones and tasteful floral touches create an inviting modern vibe. The professional and friendly service team is attentive but discreet. The restaurant is part of Das Palmberger hotel, which offers comfortable accommodation.
